name: Παραλία Αγίου Αλεξάνδρου
evidence: Two locality-anchored queries (Παλαιό Φάληρο + ελεύθερη παραλία/δήμος) still return only the homonymous church of Agios Alexandros in Palaio Faliro; no source describes amenities on the beach strip itself. Our own 'ελεύθερη παραλία χωρίς πλήρη οργάνωση' remains uncontradicted but unconfirmed.

name: Θέρετρο Αξιωματικών Ναυτικού
evidence: Disambiguated via NBNE (Naval Base South Evoikos) at Agia Marina/Kato Souli — matches our pin. limenikanea.gr feature on the ΘΑΝ beach: 'οι θέσεις των λουόμενων καθορίζονται κυρίως από τις 350 διαθέσιμες ξαπλώστρες', plus 'ντουζιέρες και Beach Bar συμπληρώνουν τις απαραίτητες ανέσεις' and all-day lifeguards. Note: access restricted to entitled Navy personnel/members.

name: Πλαζ Ραφήνας
evidence: Pin (38.019, 24.012) sits at Rafina's Κεντρική Πλαζ just south of the port — NOT Marikes (further south), where the 'Bye Bye Beach Bar' evidence belongs. For Kentriki Plaz itself only a Seatrac accessibility device install was found (iselida.gr); no sunbed/umbrella/bar evidence for this specific plaz, and a Jan 2026 port-authority notice even advised avoiding it after flood damage. Not attributing the Marikes bar to this beach.

name: Ωρωπός Σκάλα Ωρωπού
evidence: Locality is unambiguous (Skala Oropou), but the only amenity mention remains the same weak/generic line as round 1 — 'cantina-bar with umbrellas and chairs' surfacing via aggregator/hotel blurbs (travelmyth/beachsearcher). A dedicated αιγιαλός-concession search returned only national legislation, no Oropos concession for this beach. Not enough for an organized claim.

name: Τούρλος
evidence: Fetched the beach-specific allovergreece page for Tourlos, Aegina (east coast, matches our pin near Agia Marina/Vagia): 'Οργανωμένη Παραλία ΟΧΙ'; amenities listed are only ντους/αποδυτήρια/τουαλέτα (exactly our amenity set); described as 'ερημική για εσάς που αποζητάτε ηρεμία και ιδιωτικότητα'. The round-1 'organized' line was a search-snippet conflation with Perdika beaches.

name: Κύριζα
evidence: Locality confirmed (Kyriza, SE Salamina, Peristeria/Perani bay — official bathing-water profile GRBW069211099 exists for it). The 'large organized sandy beach' line is allovergreece directory boilerplate; visitor reviews and tripinview describe it as unorganized — bring your own umbrella and food. Preferring the specific visitor accounts over directory boilerplate.

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
evidence: Zogeria bay, NW Spetses, has two coves; guides (argosaronikos.gr, travelgo) place the taverna and the rented umbrella/sunbed sets (10€/σετ) in the bay, with the small cove specifically holding the taverna and sunbeds. Caveat: some sources describe the bay as a whole, so attribution to the small cove is good but not airtight.

name: Παραλία Περάματος
evidence: Second locality-anchored pass (Πειραιάς/Πέραμα) again produced no beach-specific source: Piraeus-coast results cover Votsalakia and suitability lists; Perama's shore is mostly shipyard/port frontage and no guide describes an organized beach there. No amenity claim supportable either way.

name: Αράλιμος
evidence: Locality pinned (Aralimos at Agios Ioannis Aliveriou via topo.directory), but only directory/photo listings exist; municipal and travel guides for Kymi-Aliveri beaches do not describe amenities for Aralimos specifically. Our 'χωρίς σταθερές παροχές' remains uncontradicted but no explicit statement found.

name: Ζέφυρος
evidence: Disambiguated from the Rhodes namesake: Zefiros is the cafe/beach bar ON the Nea Artaki beach (eviagreece.gr item, e-chalkida video 'Παραλία Ζέφυρος - Νέα Αρτάκη'). Sources on the Nea Artaki beachfront describe beachfront bars with umbrellas and sunbeds (extra charge for sunbeds on weekends), with Zefiros named as the beachfront venue at this spot.

name: Κακιά
evidence: Kalamos double beach clearly disambiguated: the northern cove 'Καλή' has the sunbeds/cafes/tavernas; the second cove 'Κακιά' (ours) is explicitly the wild one — 'πιο άγρια ομορφιά χωρίς ξαπλώστρες', used mainly for free camping (travel.gr / visit-kimi-aliveri / ghettomagazine all agree).

name: Καναπίτσα
evidence: Kanapitsa here is the Chalkida-area suburb (pin 38.47, 23.60), not Skiathos — but even locality-anchored queries return only restaurants/ouzeri in the Kanapitsa district (e.g. '25 Δράμια') with sea view, no description of a beach with amenities. Skiathos collision dominates everything else.

name: Μακρύς Γιαλός
evidence: Disambiguated to Makrys Gialos / Makrygialos 2.5km south of Vlachia, North Evia (theblogofdimi, e-camping forum, YouTube titles all name Vlachia). Consistently described as a campers' beach: municipal/semi-organized camping in the plane-tree forest, a canteen and a beachfront restaurant, southern part quiet with no shade — no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or a beach bar on the sand.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου
evidence: Could not pin the exact locality: our coordinates (39.015, 23.342, north Evia coast) do not match either well-documented namesake (Agios Nikolaos Aidipsou at ~38.90/23.02, described as not organized with seasonal beach bars, or Agios Nikolaos at Ellinika ~38.996/23.419). Without locality certainty no verdict is safe.

name: Παραλία Βλαχιάς
evidence: Locality certain (Vlachia village beach, North Evia). Sources (eviaportal, eviagreece) list a καφετέρια-ταβέρνα, a souvlaki canteen and a mini market at the beach — matching our food amenities — but none mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or calls it organized; none calls it explicitly unorganized either. Food yes, organization unproven.

name: Παραλία Γιάλτρων
evidence: Locality certain (Loutra Gialtron, NW Evia). Best evidence remains 'η πιο αμμώδης αριστερή πλευρά από το λιμανάκι είναι πιο οργανωμένη' (comparative, no explicit sunbeds), while the 'three beach bars with loungers' found are on the Aidipsos–Lichada road, not attributable to this beach. Also easy to confuse with nearby Mpania Gialtron. Insufficient.

name: Παραλία Δάφνης
evidence: Disambiguated to Dafni Nerotrivias (west-coast central Evia, matches pin 38.63/23.49; the other Dafni is at Chiliadou on the Aegean side). eviaportal's beach-specific page: a seasonal 'beach bar με εστιατόριο' operates on the first section and 'βγάζει μερικές ομπρέλες' when open, plus a taverna on the second section — but it advises bringing your own gear and never mentions ξαπλώστρες. Beach bar confirmed; sunbeds unconfirmed and organization is partial/seasonal.

name: Πέλαγος
evidence: No source found for a distinct beach named 'Πέλαγος' near Nea Artaki (pin 38.483/23.577); results describe the general Nea Artaki beachfront (bars with umbrellas/loungers) but never name Pelagos, so nothing can be attributed to this specific record.

name: Πόρτο Λάφια
evidence: Locality certain (Porto Lafia/Elafolimano, Styra, SW Evia). in.gr and evia-guide describe a long quiet sandy beach with a canteen and a taverna along it; no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or a beach bar, and the in.gr history piece notes grand development plans were never realized — 'ο τελευταίος παράδεισος' framing implies undeveloped. Food yes, beach furniture no.

name: Ροδιές
evidence: Second pass still finds no beach source named 'Ροδιές' near Nea Artaki — only a Rodies apartment listing 'near Asterias beach Chalkida' and the Ροβιές (Rovies) name collision. Cannot attribute any amenity either way.

name: Σουβάλα
evidence: Disambiguated from the Aegina namesake: our pin matches Πλαζ Σουβάλα at Chalkida's north port (YouTube 'Χαλκίδα Παραλία (Πλαζ Σουβάλα)', egnomi coverage, official bathing-water profile GRBW079155162). The bathing-water profile states part of the beach is organized with permanent umbrellas, showers and bins (municipal-style). No sunbed-rental or beach-bar evidence.

name: Στενή
evidence: Pin (38.045, 24.32) is on the coast near Marmari, South Evia, but every search collapses to the mountain village Steni Dirfyos or generic Marmari beaches; no source documents a beach named Στενή here. Unresolvable.

name: Σχοινοδαύλεια
evidence: Locality certain (remote SE Evia 'unknown exotic beach' with gorge/pond/stalactites features, consistent across round 1 and this pass). All descriptions are of a remote undiscovered beach; no source mentions any facility, and the access/character make organization implausible. Matches our 'χωρίς σταθερές παροχές'. No explicit 'μη οργανωμένη' quote, hence medium not high.

name: Γιάννακης
evidence: Locality pinned via exploring-greece: 'Η Παραλία Γιάννακη βρίσκεται στην Πέρα Πάντα... πριν από την είσοδο της Σχολής Τουριστικών Επαγγελμάτων' near Itea — a locals' quick-dip fine-pebble beach. No source states whether it has sunbeds/bar; nearby Itea beaches with sunbeds (Trokantero) are separate. No explicit unorganized statement either.

name: Μονιά
evidence: Second pass still finds no source for a beach named Μονιά near Itea/Pera Panta (pin 38.378/22.391); Fokida beach guides list Trokantero, Vrachakia, Monastiraki (the round-1 collision) but never Monia. Unresolvable.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Μηνά
evidence: Locality certain: Agios Minas at Genimakia, Desfina — the Corinthian-gulf cove between Chiliadou and Monastiraki, matching our pin. The local municipal-community site e-desfina.gr states a canteen with the emblematic name «Ο ΑΓΙΟΣ» operates on the beach offering everything 'από νερό μέχρι ξαπλώστρα'. This local, beach-specific source outweighs the generic 'δεν θα βρεις beach bar ή ομπρέλες' guide line; sunbeds are canteen-run and seasonal, no beach bar.

name: Άι Γιάννης
evidence: Pin (38.725, 23.061) is the Agios Ioannis beach by Livanates (confirmed by the whitewashed cliff chapel of Ai Giannis over the Euboean Gulf). The round-1 'Agios Ioannis beach bar renting sunbeds' belongs to Theologos ~20km away and the 'organized Agios Ioannis' to Alykes — neither attributable here. No amenity statement found for the Livanates beach itself.

name: Κέδρος
evidence: Pinned to the Raches/Achinos coast of Stylida (Maliakos gulf) via lat/lng. Multiple query variants (Κέδρος + Ράχες / Αχινός / Στυλίδα) return only the famous Kedros of Donousa or the generally organized Raches main beach; no source names a Kedros beach in Fthiotida at all. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Γεωργίου Πελασγίας
evidence: Disambiguated to Agios Georgios of Pelasgia, Stylida/Fthiotida (matches lat/lng and the small church + parking-by-the-church detail). Local sources (stilida.com / foursquare listing) state it 'is not an organized beach — bring water, food and umbrellas'. An earlier vaguer mention of municipally-installed umbrellas could not be tied to this beach; the specific local description wins.

name: Σχοινιά
evidence: Disambiguated from Schinias Attica by anchoring on Livanates (lat/lng matches the Livanates coast, Dimos Lokron). Multiple specific sources: municipality-placed umbrellas and showers on Schinias Livanates beach (fonografos.net), plus named on-beach operators Blanco Beach Bar and Barracuda Beach Bar offering free sunbeds and umbrellas (pointfinder.eu listings with phone numbers).

name: Λαιμός
evidence: Pinned to Laimos on the Corinthian gulf coast of Viotia past the Alyki archaeological site (matches lat/lng). Sources only say it is reached 'by a mountainous, difficult dirt road requiring 4x4' — strongly suggesting no facilities, but no source explicitly states unorganized/no sunbeds. WonderGreece detail page unreachable (expired certificate).

name: Agios Nikolaos
evidence: Agios Nikolaos Sithonia is an inland village; its coastal area (lat/lng points to the shore NW of Ormos Panagias) is covered by directories (sithoniagreece.com) that list only Akti Salonikiou, Schinia and Elaion nearby — none named 'Agios Nikolaos' and no facility info. Organized beaches in the area (Trani Ammouda etc.) are distinct beaches; cannot pin any sunbed/bar claim to this record.

name: Λύκος
evidence: Unambiguous locality: Lykos/Likkos bay, Sfakia south coast between Loutro and Marmara (matches lat/lng). Taverna Akrogiali sits directly on Lykos beach and its listings state it 'offers sunbeds'; Georgoshouse (also on the bay) advertises free sunbeds and hammocks adjoining the beach. Sunbeds are taverna/guesthouse-provided rather than a concession, and cretanbeaches confirms only tavernas with rooms — no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Θανάσης
evidence: Pinned via lat/lng to the western beach of Stavros, Akrotiri Chania — documented as 'beach near Taverna Thanasis, Stavros, Akrotiri peninsula' (Alamy caption confirms the name/place pairing). Multiple guides (cretanbeaches, elizabethestateagency) state Stavros has two sandy beaches 'organized with canteens, umbrellas and sun beds'. Sunbeds inferred for this specific (Thanasis/western) beach from that two-beach statement, hence not high confidence.

name: Παραλία Χαλέπα
evidence: Lat/lng lands on the Chalepa quarter shore of Chania town. The swimming spot of Chalepa (Kouloura) is explicitly described: 'not a typical beach with umbrellas, beach bars and crowds… you won't find sunbeds or music there' (cretaone/despinastudios). No source describes any organized section on the Chalepa shoreline.

name: Άμμος Ξερόκαμπου
evidence: Xerokambos (Zakros, Sitia) confirmed via lat/lng. Cretanbeaches' Xerokambos page lists umbrellas/showers only as general-area amenities and gives no per-beach details for the Ammos sub-beach; guides stress the area is remote with tavernas only in the settlement. Cannot tie sunbeds to this specific sub-beach.

name: Βόλια
evidence: Round-1 tied this to Xerokambos, but the lat/lng (35.320, 25.567) is on the north coast just west of Milatos — the Volaki area, where cretanbeaches says a hotel (Minos Imperial) 'created two artificial beaches with sand on either side of a concrete pier'. Hotel beach almost certainly has hotel sunbeds, but no source explicitly states sunbeds/public organization, so staying UNCLEAR per the rules.

name: Βουρλιά
evidence: Lat/lng matches Vourlia, the central-settlement beach of Xerokambos. Cretanbeaches (a reputable Crete guide, upgrading round-1's 'low-quality map listing') describes the Vourlia settlement beach as 'αρκετά οργανωμένη' (fairly organized) and lists umbrellas among the beach's amenities; tavernas are in the settlement. No explicit sunbed count, hence sunbeds left null and confidence medium.

name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
evidence: Unambiguous locality (Chiona, 2 km from Palaikastro, Sitia — matches lat/lng). Resolving the round-1 conflict: cretazine and crete-today both state the beach has 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' (a few sunbeds and umbrellas) plus tamarisks, and famous fish tavernas directly on the beach (e.g. Chiona tavern). So lightly but genuinely organized: few sunbeds yes, no beach bar.

name: Palm Bay Beach
evidence: Lat/lng = Sissi, Lasithi, in front of the Palm Bay Hotel (by Estia). Hotel pages confirm 'direct beachfront access' but the sun loungers/umbrellas described are at the pool, not on the shore; the Sissi coast there is rocky and no source describes any organized public beach called Palm Bay. Unresolvable beyond the hotel itself.

name: Παραλία Γαλάνης Νέστου
evidence: This is the river beach at Galani village on the Nestos straits, Xanthi (lat/lng is inland on the river — matches). A dedicated canteen ('Καντίνα Γαλάνη Νέστος', with Facebook page and digital menu) operates at the end of the road at this exact spot, confirming food on site, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or any beach organization for the river beach itself.

name: Παραλία Σαλαώρας
evidence: Salaora on the Amvrakikos gulf, Arta (unambiguous, matches lat/lng). Topoguide's detailed National-Park page describes a ~1 km shell-gravel shore and birdwatching but mentions no facilities; only the Seatrac sea-access listing exists. No sunbed/umbrella/bar statement either way after multiple query variants.

name: Άη Γιαννάκης
evidence: Ai Giannakis on the Parga–Preveza road, 6 km before Parga (matches lat/lng). Two dedicated pages (taxidologio.gr, travelpreveza.gr) state it is 'οργανωμένη, με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες και θαλάσσια σπορ' with food businesses very close. One round-1 source claimed only a canteen above the beach; the more specific dedicated beach pages win, but the conflict caps confidence at medium.

name: Παντοκράτορας
evidence: Pantokratoras town beach, 2.5 km from Preveza centre (matches lat/lng). Official/local sources (visitpreveza.gr, prevezaguide) state the beach has some umbrellas and showers, free sunbeds for bathers, and a restaurant and cafeteria right by the sea. Minimal but explicit on-beach organization; the food venues are beside the beach, not a beach bar.

name: Παραλία Ριζών
evidence: Rizon/Riza beach below the Lekatsa forest, ~28 km from Preveza (matches lat/lng). The conflict persists at source level: visitpreveza.gr says a few free umbrellas and sunbeds exist, while travelpreveza/discoverpreveza say the beach is not organized with no umbrellas, sunbeds or beach bar (tavernas/camping are in the wider area). Equally specific official-adjacent sources contradicting each other — cannot responsibly claim either way.

name: Παραλία Έλενα
evidence: Resolved the round-1 mystery: this is the private beach of Camping Elena's Beach at Plataria, Thesprotia (campsite address and bay match lat/lng). The campsite has its own beach, a restaurant-cafeteria and mini market, but its official facilities page does not list beach umbrellas or sunbeds, and no independent source describes beach organization. Food exists on-site; sunbeds unverified.

name: Black Rocks Beach
evidence: Black Rocks at the far southern end of Agios Gordios, Corfu (matches lat/lng). Black Rocks Seaside Restaurant Bar sits at the water's edge on this beach and Tripadvisor reviewers state 'the sunbeds are free to use if you buy drinks etc'; the Black Rocks establishment also advertises its own sandy coves with free sunbeds and umbrellas. Patron-model sunbeds + an on-beach restaurant-bar = organized, though guest-priority wording caps confidence at medium.

name: Kanoni Beach
evidence: Name collision resolved by lat/lng (39.794, 19.920): this is Kanoni at Kassiopi, NOT Kanoni of Corfu Town (39.585). Multiple dedicated pages (Greeka, Lovin' Corfu, Sandee, mykerkyra) confirm sunbeds and umbrellas for rent on the rock platforms/hill, a small bar serving the beach, and a taverna next to it.

name: Καλυβιώτης
evidence: Lat/lng points to the Gardenos/Perivoli shore of south Corfu, where 'Taverna Aristos Kalyviotis' operates (the beach is evidently named after it) — consistent with our 'ταβέρνα' amenity. However, no source describes sunbeds, umbrellas or a beach bar at this beach; only the taverna's existence is confirmed.

name: Παραλία Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Lat/lng (39.674, 19.847) lands on Corfu's east coast around Dassia/Kato Korakiana, but no source names an 'Agios Nikolaos' beach there; searches return only the organized Dassia and Ipsos beaches or Agios Nikolaos namesakes on other islands. Cannot pin the record to a documented beach — no facility claim possible.

name: Παραλία Λογγάς
evidence: Loggas/Sunset beach at Peroulades, NW Corfu (matches lat/lng). Majority of dedicated sources (Lovin' Corfu, OnlyInCorfu, projectcorfu) state the narrow beach under the cliffs is unorganized with no sunbeds or umbrellas; the famous 7th Heaven cafe-bar and taverna sit on the cliff top ABOVE the beach, not on it. A minority 'few sunbeds for rent' claim exists, but the specific consensus and the beach's physically vanishing strip favour unorganized.

name: Παραλία Παρακλάδι
evidence: Parakladi near Lefkimmi, SE Corfu (lat/lng in the Lefkimmi coastal strip). Second-round searches in Greek and English return only beach directories with no facility content for Parakladi; the documented organized beaches of the area (Alikes, Molos, Bouka) are distinct. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Δεύτερη Σπιάντζα
evidence: Defteri ('Second') Spiantza, ~1.1 km south of Gaios, Paxos (matches lat/lng). Sources describe only a small pebbly cove enclosed by low rocky cliffs near town; no facility information found in any guide (thinkingtraveller, cycladia, monolitharo). Likely bare, but no explicit 'unorganized' statement, so staying UNCLEAR.

name: Πόρτο
evidence: Porto, the main port beach of Erikoussa (unambiguous — one settlement on the island, matches lat/lng). Tripadvisor hotel/beach reviews state 'there are sunbeds you can rent daily at the beach' (~€10/day for two) and the hotel section of the beach rents lounge chairs and umbrellas; tavernas (e.g. Leonidas') serve food by the beach. No beach bar as such.

name: Central Square Beach
evidence: Pin (38.151, 20.776) is Poros town, Kefalonia. Poros main beach (NE of town) is semi-organized with sunbed/parasol sets (Greeka, JustKefalonia), but 'Central Square Beach' appears to be the informal strip at the town centre and no source describes that specific strip; cannot attribute the main-beach sunbeds to it.

name: Αθέρας
evidence: Pin matches Porto Atheras, Paliki, Kefalonia. Multiple beach-specific guides agree: 'no sunbeds or parasols to rent are available... two seasonal tavernas'; 'the beach is not organized... bring your own umbrella'; small changing hut only, restrooms at the tavernas (nomadekefalonia, Greeka, kefaloniabyanna).

name: Βραχινάρι
evidence: Pin = end of Vatsa Bay, Paliki. Only source (1001beach, round 1) describes a quiet cozy sandy beach with fenced turtle nests and mentions no sunbeds or bar; no explicit 'unorganized' statement and no second source found, so left unresolved.

name: Καραβόμυλος
evidence: Pin matches Karavomilos village beach at Sami. Kefaloniaguide's page for this exact beach (main beach of Sami, next to the lake mill) says visitors can use provided sun loungers and umbrellas; the beachfront Ionian Emerald resort area also keeps loungers/umbrellas on the beach. No distinct beach bar confirmed.

name: Παραλία Αγία Βαρβάρα
evidence: Pin matches Agia Varvara, the main Katelios beach. Beach-specific sources (WonderGreece Katelios–Agia Varvara, kefaloniabyanna, kefalonia.ws) say sunbeds/umbrellas are available for hire on the main section — often taverna-run — while the far turtle-nesting section past the stream is undeveloped. Partly organized overall; sunbeds confirmed, no standalone beach bar.

name: Λιθοβάτης
evidence: No source describing Lithovatis (near Agia Efimia, Kefalonia) was found in either round; our own data already says 'χωρίς παροχές πάνω στην ακτή' but no external confirmation either way.

name: Νότια Παραλία Νικιάνας
evidence: Pin (38.758, 20.721) = southern stretch of Nikiana towards Episkopos, Lefkada. amazinglefkada: 'just about enough room for one row of sunbeds along most of the beach, belonging to the hotels behind' plus a beach cantina renting sunbeds/umbrellas; the adjacent Episkopos-Nikiana beach immediately south is well organized with sunbed pairs and a beach bar (Greeka). Sunbeds present on the south stretch; dedicated beach bar not confirmed for this exact strip.

name: Αμπελάκια
evidence: No source specific to Ampelakia on Meganisi found (name collides with Peloponnese/Salamina beaches); Meganisi guides state only Fanari is fully organized on the island, which casts doubt on our claimed showers/changing rooms/WC, but there is no explicit statement about this cove.

name: Μικρή Ξύγκια
evidence: Disambiguated as Xigia 'Dipla', the small cove next to main Xigia (Zakynthos). rezante/ecozante: 'usually only a few umbrellas and sunbeds, so best take your own'; 'no beach bars, canteens or much civilization' at the cove (canteen is at main Xigia). Sparse/seasonal sunbeds too unreliable to claim organized; no bar confirmed negative.

name: Μαδράκια
evidence: Pin matches Madrakia by the port of Agios Nikolaos (Volimes), Zakynthos. Beach-specific pages (Greeka Madrakia, beaches-searcher) describe the small sandy stretch by the family-run Madrakia Taverna with 'basic amenities, such as deckchairs & umbrellas, beach bars, toilets'. Sunbeds confirmed; food is the shoreline taverna.

name: Βουρδέρη
evidence: Pin matches Vourderi in Vasilikos, Zakynthos. The local Vasilikos guide's page for this exact beach: 'Along the beach there are many beach bars, sun beds and umbrellas', contrasted with nearby beaches that have none; Celia Apartments sits above this beach confirming the locality.

name: Παραλία Δεξά
evidence: Dexa/Dexia near Vathy, Ithaca (pin matches). Multiple beach-specific sources (ithacorama, Greeka, Tripadvisor reviews): sunbeds/umbrellas for rent in peak season (~10 EUR per pair), small canteen/bar serving drinks and snacks, lifeguard in season, plus natural olive-tree shade. Resolves the round-1 'canteen only' doubt.

name: Κατσούνι
evidence: Disambiguated to Psara (pin at the settlement's east side; Rhodes/Anafi namesakes excluded). Psara-specific pages (WonderGreece Psara Katsouni, greecevacationsearch Psara entry) describe it as the island's most popular sandy beach with sunbeds, WC and parking, hosting summer beach-volley tournaments. No beach bar confirmed.

name: Φύτεμα
evidence: Fytema near Evdilos, Ikaria: only evidence is the Popi taverna at Fytema (food nearby confirmed); Ikaria organized-beach lists (Mesakti, Livadi, Kampos, Gialiskari) never include Fytema, but no source states sunbeds present or absent for this beach.

name: Αυλάκι
evidence: Pin (38.967, 26.438) is the Kratigos/Haramida area south of Mytilene. All 'Avlaki' hits are namesakes elsewhere (Avlaki Taverna between Petra and Anaxos ~40km away, plus Corfu/Crete/Attica); the Mytilene municipality beach list does not resolve an Avlaki here. Cannot pin the locality, so no verdict.

name: Παραλία Δρότας
evidence: Drota near Plomari, Lesvos (pin matches). The Drota taverna-ouzeri (drota.gr) sits on the beach, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas; regional guides group it with the quiet natural Plomari-area beaches. Leaning unorganized-with-taverna but no explicit statement found.

name: Παραλία Καγιά
evidence: Kagia east of Skala Sikamnias, Lesvos (pin matches). 1001beach notes tamarisk shade, showers and changing cabins and the Kagia fish taverna, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or an explicit unorganized statement; showers suggest some municipal provision only.

name: Τσιχράντα
evidence: Mikri/Megali Tsichranta coves west of Anaxos, Lesvos (pin matches Kechrada area). Visit Lesvos and Yallou describe small idyllic coves 'ideal for isolation and quiet swimming' with parking only; no facility list and no explicit unorganized statement, so unresolved (leans unorganized).

name: Μπάλος
evidence: Balos in Ormos Koumeikon, SW Samos (pin matches; Crete namesake excluded). The official Greek bathing-water profile for this exact beach (GRBW149264276) states a section is organized with umbrellas, loungers, changing rooms and bins; samosin.gr's older 'not organized, tavernas on the road' conflicts but the official beach-specific profile is more authoritative. Tavernas are roadside, no beach bar.

name: Μικρά Λεμονάκια
evidence: All sources describe only the main Lemonakia beach near Kokkari (well organized: sunbeds, umbrellas, seaside taverna). Our pin (37.778, 26.897) sits closer to Kokkari than to main Lemonakia (26.887) and no source distinguishes a 'Mikra Lemonakia' cove, so the organized evidence cannot be safely attributed.

name: Μπούκα
evidence: Pin (37.333, 23.124) is on the Ermionida coast north of Kosta/Porto Heli. All 'Bouka organized' evidence still refers to Bouka in Messinia; nearby organized beaches (Kosta, Hinitsa) are distinct named beaches. No Argolida-Bouka-specific source found in two rounds.

name: Παραλία Βαγιωνία
evidence: Disambiguated: pin (37.641, 23.159) = Vagionia at the right-hand entrance of the harbour of Palaia Epidavros, behind Agios Nikolaos church (Terrabook Argolida) — NOT the organized Vagionia on Poros island. Terrabook: 'χωρίς πολλές ξαπλώστρες, μόνο κάμποσες ψάθινες ομπρέλες, πάνω στο βότσαλο και την άμμο' — a few fixed straw umbrellas only, no sunbeds, no bar/canteen; visitors advised to bring supplies. The round-1 'organized with cafe' claim matched the Poros namesake.

name: Πλαζ Αλκυονίδας
evidence: Pin (38.067, 22.992) is the Schinos/Strava shore of the Alkyonides Gulf, Korinthia. Guides describe Schinos and Strava-Alkyoni as quiet pebble shores but no source names or describes a 'Plaz Alkyonidas' beach with facilities; the round-1 Alepochori evidence is a different beach across the gulf.

name: Σιδερώνα
evidence: Siderona near Korfos, Korinthia (pin matches). Beach-specific Greek sources: 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα' whose fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — the taverna puts a few umbrellas and sunbeds on the shore. Sunbeds genuinely present (taverna-run, limited); no beach bar.

name: Αρτάνη
evidence: Artani near Archangelos/Plytra, Lakonia: after two rounds only a Facebook page exists; no travel guide, concession decision or review describing facilities was found.

name: Βιανδίνη (Βούρκος)
evidence: Small pebble beach just south of Elia, Lakonia (pin matches). Only an aggregator entry ('small pebbly beach ~0.23km') with no facility information; no sunbed/bar evidence in either direction.

name: Λιμάνι
evidence: Limani at Elia, Monemvasia municipality (pin matches). The beach itself is a narrow 4-5m sand strip with no facilities; bathers use the harbour mole where sunbeds are placed ('στον λιμενοβραχίονα... υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες'), framed by cafe-restaurants. Sunbeds exist adjacent on the jetty, not on the beach — too ambiguous to claim the beach organized.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Pin (36.976, 21.658) is on the Ionian coast between Marathopoli and Vromoneri (Trifylia), NOT the Mani village that round 1 (and all search results) describe — the Pantazi-beach sunbed evidence belongs to Agios Nikolaos of Messinian Mani, a different coast entirely. No source exists for an Agios Nikolaos beach at this Marathopoli-area locality; the Gargaliani beach lists (Marathos, Lagouvardos, Ai-Giannakis, Vromoneri, Agia Sotira, Chrysi Akti) do not include one.

name: Βρωμονέρι
evidence: Disambiguated to the Vromoneri settlement 7 km from Gargaliani (matches pin 37.018, 21.620). messinia.mobi/completegreece beach pages: «Μέρος της αποτελεί οργανωμένη παραλία, με beach bar, ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, beach-volley» — the rest of the beach stays free. Corroborated by the round-1 2025 municipal umbrella/sunbed concession auction for this beach.

name: Λιβάδια
evidence: Pin (36.795, 21.964) resolves to Koroni, not the island namesakes round 1 hit. koroni-messinias.gr lists «Παραλία κάτω από το κάστρο (Λειβαδιά)» so the beach exists at Koroni, but the page is a photo gallery with no facilities text; the organized Koroni beaches with sunbeds are Zaga and Memi, distinct beaches. No facility statement found for Livadia itself.

name: Παραλία Σάλιο
evidence: Disambiguated to the cove by Trachila village, Messinian Mani (pin 36.888, 22.231). Salio is reached only via a footpath starting at a bend before the village (messinianmani.gr, AllTrails lists it as a hike POI); the area's beaches are described as untouched by mass tourism. No source mentions any commercial facility; inference from path-only access, not an explicit statement.

name: Παραλία Χωμάτι
evidence: Disambiguated to the beach below Vounaria village north of Koroni (pin 36.83, 21.932). Athinorama: «οι παραλίες Περούλια και Χωμάτι (κάτω από το χωριό Βουνάρια) με τους αμμόλοφους και τις καλαμιές είναι το κρυμμένο μυστικό των ντόπιων» — described as a locals' hidden spot with dunes and reeds; no source mentions any facility. Not an explicit 'unorganized' statement, hence low confidence.

name: Ξετρυπητή
evidence: Anafi-wide sources are unanimous: the island's beaches «δεν είναι οργανωμένες», no sunbeds even at the top beaches (travel.gr: 'Πεντακάθαρα νερά και ειδυλλιακά τοπία χωρίς ξαπλώστρες'; greecedestination: 'virgin beaches... not organized'). Xetrypiti is a minor remote beach that does not appear in any organized listing; on an island where even Kleisidi/Katsouni lack full organization, facilities here are implausible.

name: Σιφνέικο
evidence: Locality confirmed (Sifneiko/Sunset beach, west coast of Antiparos town). Sources conflict: one guide says 'a single small bar near the middle... limited sunbeds', another says 'largely unorganized, no sunbeds or immediate bars'. The adjacent Sunset Antiparos bar operates evenings only (18:00-00:30) for drinks, not daytime sunbed service. Cannot safely claim daytime organization.

name: Καλαμίτσι
evidence: Disambiguated to Kimolos (south side, next to Bonatsa) — Halkidiki/Lefkada namesakes excluded. Kimolos-specific guides (feelgreece/allovergreece) describe it as «ανοργάνωτη παραλία», a small sandy cove with tamarisks where locals bring children; only facility is a taverna ~10 m behind the beach — no sunbeds, no bar.

name: Μαυροσπηλιά
evidence: Kimolos-specific pages agree: 'the beach is not organized but a refreshment stand (αναψυκτήριο) operates' selling water/soft drinks/snacks, and visitors are told to bring their own umbrella since there is no shade. The round-1 'sunbeds in recent years' claim is contradicted by the more specific current descriptions; canteen is not a beach bar.

name: Άγιος Στέφανος
evidence: Locality pinned (bay in front of the Agios Stefanos settlement, east Kythnos). kythnos.net describes sand/pebbles and plenty of tamarisk shade along its length, but neither confirms sunbeds nor states it is unorganized; all sunbed hits are Corfu/Kos/Mykonos namesakes. Island-wide 'very few Kythnos beaches are organized' but not beach-specific.

name: Αγία Ειρήνη
evidence: Disambiguated to the beach opposite Loutra, NE Kythnos (kythnos.net page is beach-specific): «Επειδή πρόκειται για μια μικρή μη οργανωμένη παραλία καλό θα είναι να προσέλθετε με τα βασικά» — small non-organized beach, shade only from scattered tamarisks.

name: Παραλία Κολώνα
evidence: Kythnos Kolona unambiguous (isthmus to Agios Loukas islet). Recent specific reports: one section rents umbrellas/sunbeds at €30 for 2 front-row / €20 back row, plus a taverna above the beach and a café-snack beach bar. Older guides still say 'not organized, bring equipment' — the priced, operator-specific recent account wins per recency/specificity; main sandy isthmus remains free.

name: Κήποι
evidence: Second pass (Greek 'Κήπος Μήλος οργανωμένη/καντίνα' variants) still returns no Milos-specific facility source — results collide with Kipos Samothraki and generic Milos guides that describe other organized beaches (Fyriplaka, Provatas) but say nothing about this south-coast beach. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Αγία Άννα
evidence: Pin (37.4489, 25.3298) is the small Agia Anna town beach at Mykonos Chora. Mykonos has three Agia Anna bearers: the Kalafatis one (sunbeds, beach volley, diving center) and the Paraga one (sunbeds/umbrellas) — both ~25.34-25.42 lng, not this one. No facility source found for the Chora town beach itself; all organized-beach evidence belongs to the namesakes.

name: Αγία Τριάδα
evidence: Pin (37.4149, 25.2124) is not on Mykonos at all — it is on Rhenia (Rineia), the uninhabited islet west of Delos. Sources confirm Agia Triada is one of Rhenia's west-coast beaches by the chapel/abandoned farmhouses: the island is uninhabited with 'many deserted, sandy beaches' reachable only by boat. No inhabitants, no facilities possible.

name: Άμπραμ
evidence: Locality certain (NW Naxos coast between Chora and Apollonas). Naxos-specific pages (allovergreece, naxos-tours) describe a small sandy cove with a small settlement and a taverna next to it, 'less developed' than the organized west-coast beaches — but no source explicitly states presence or absence of sunbeds, and the taverna is adjacent rather than a beach bar.

name: Παραλία Αγκάλη Χρυσής Ακτής
evidence: All facility evidence (umbrellas/sunbeds for rent, beach bars, windsurf centers) is for the main Chrysi Akti / Golden Beach and Punda; no source individuates the Agkali sub-cove at the pin. Per the no-adjacent-beach-promotion rule this stays unresolved.

name: Κάθαρος
evidence: Katharos below Oia, Santorini — beach-specific pages are explicit and consistent: 'unorganized beach with no sunbeds along the shore... no facilities, no shower, no sunbed rentals or toilet' (santorini-view; santorini-more agrees: no commercial amenities). The Katharos Lounge meze bar is above/off the beach (matches our 'εκτός ακτής' note). The round-1 'umbrellas exist' claim is contradicted by the more specific beach pages.

name: Σεράλια
evidence: Locality certain (~30 m pebble cove at Kastro's old port, Sifnos). One aggregated account mentions 'some municipal umbrellas', while the beach-specific pages (sifnosinfo, roomsinsifnos) describe only the tiny pebble beach with small tavernas adjacent and warn of waves/undercurrents — no sunbed/organization statement. Conflicting and thin; not promoted.

name: Αγκάλη
evidence: Second pass still cannot pin an 'Agkali' beach on Tinos: a bare Tripadvisor stub ('Agali Beach, Tinos') exists with no content, and every substantive result is the Folegandros, Evia or Thesprotia namesake. Tinos beach roundups (tinos360, tinosecret) between Chora and Kionia list Stavros/Agios Markos but no Agkali. Unresolvable.

name: Παραλία Σταυρός
evidence: Disambiguated: Stavros just after Tinos Chora towards Kionia, the old port with the namesake chapel (matches pin) — Crete/Chalkidiki/Donousa namesakes excluded. tinosecret.gr beach-specific listing states 'ORGANIZED: No' — sandy, shallow, natural tree shade, busy despite lacking formal facilities. An αναψυκτήριο operates by the church (off-beach), matching our existing amenity note.

name: Ψιλή Άμμος
evidence: Disambiguated to Schinoussa (500 m from Mesaria, NE coast; Samos/Thasos/Fourni namesakes excluded). Schinoussa-specific sources: 'There is no organization whatsoever at the beach, so you will need to bring all necessary supplies' — 60 m of sand and dunes, shade only from tamarisks.

name: Άγιος Βασίλειος
evidence: Beach right after Livadi, Astypalaia, named for the church there. The island's dedicated beach page (astypalaia-island.gr) describes only relaxing 'under the shade of the huge trees along the beach', calls it 'quite quiet and peaceful' and under-visited, and lists no sunbeds/canteen/bar — explicitly contrasted with the organized, cosmopolitan Livadi next door. Absence-based, hence low confidence.

name: Μακρύγιαλος
evidence: Second pass confirms round 1: every substantive 'Makrygialos' result is Crete (Lasithi, organized) or Pieria — both wrong localities. No Karpathos source (municipal all-beaches page, allovergreece's 41 Karpathos beaches, discovergreece top-10) mentions a Makrygialos at the pin (35.425, 27.151, SE coast near Amoopi?). The windsurf/beach-bar amenity claims cannot be verified for Karpathos; genuinely unresolvable.

name: Μανδράκι
evidence: Locality certain (Mandraki district east of Kastellorizo harbor, by the cemetery — the islet's only small sandy patch, which the municipality tops up with sand each summer). Conflicting/vague: greecedestination says sunbeds/umbrellas 'are placed by the Municipality and in very few places' (island-wide, not clearly at Mandraki), while the beach-specific cavoblue page describes only pebbles/sand and clean shallow water with no facility mention. Cannot pin municipal sunbeds to this exact spot.

name: Πλάκες
evidence: Plakes on Kastellorizo is a natural flat-rock (slippery slabs) swimming spot, not a serviced beach; the organized swimming area of the island — sunbeds and a small taverna — is on the Agios Georgios islet reached by boat, a different location. No source attributes any facility to Plakes itself. Absence-based inference, low confidence.

name: Άσπρη
evidence: Aspri, Patmos: small isolated cove between Skala and Meloi with view of the Monastery (matches pin). patmosislandinfo/taxidologio describe sand and fine pebble, tamarisks for shade and a fish taverna at one end; explicitly characterized as quiet/isolated, never listed among Patmos' organized beaches, and no sunbed mention anywhere. Taverna at the edge is not a beach bar.

name: Άγιος Θεολόγος
evidence: Disambiguated from the Kos namesake via Patmos-specific sources: this is the beach on the north side of Skala harbour (matches lat 37.326). patmosislandgreece.com states explicitly: 'There are no sun beds on the beach, but there are plenty of Tamarisk trees' and 'Two Cafes have their chairs with umbrellas for shade right next to the shore'. Multiple guides call it 'not organized'. Cafes/tavernas adjacent but no sunbed/umbrella rental operation and no beach bar.

name: Σάψιλα
evidence: Greeka page for the specific Sapsila beach between Skala and Grikos, Patmos (matches coords): 'The beach is not organized, so there are no sunbeds or umbrellas available here.' Restaurants exist in the settlement nearby but not on the beach.

name: Παραλία Αλυκή
evidence: Coordinate disambiguation corrected round1: lat 36.108/lng 27.730 is the WEST coast below Monolithos, Rhodes — matching Greeka's 'Just below the village of Monolithos, about 75 km southwest of Rhodes Town'. Greeka: 'Alyki Beach is unorganized, however you will find a handful of sunbeds available for rent'; Tripadvisor reviews confirm 'a dozen umbrellas with sunbeds for rent' run by a named manager. 'No shops or canteens in the area' — sunbed/umbrella rental yes, no bar/canteen. Minimal operation (a dozen sets).

name: Παραλία Γαλούνι
evidence: Only evidence remains municipal: the Rhodes 2026 aigialos-concession map (dimokratiki.gr) lists a 150 τ.μ. umbrella-concession plot with toponym 'ΓΑΛΟΥΝΙ' in the Νότια Ρόδος section — an auctioned plot, not proof an operator actually runs sunbeds there. No Tripadvisor page, no guide coverage, no taverna/bar evidence for this remote stretch. Bias to under-claim.

name: Σύμη Γυάλα
evidence: Dedicated Tripadvisor attraction 'Giala beach bar' listed under Emporios (Nimborio), Symi — same locality as the coords (36.621/27.821, adjacent to Nimborio). Accommodation pages in Nimborio describe Gyala as 'a lovely beach which also has a summer bar under the tamarisk trees', a 200 m walk from Nimborio. Beach bar confirmed at this specific beach; no explicit sunbed evidence, so sunbeds left null.

name: Μαράθι
evidence: Disambiguated from Marathi/Crete (all sunbed hits belonged to the Cretan beach). For the islet near Arki: multiple Greek sources confirm 'two taverns at the two edges of the beach' (Pantelis since 1978, plus Michalis/Marathi) on the single sandy harbour bay — but neither marathi-island.gr nor any guide explicitly mentions sunbeds/umbrellas on the beach (the only 'sun beds' quote is a private terrace), and one source describes the wider islets as service-free. Tavernas on-beach yes; organized sunbed/bar operation unproven.

name: Mirtia Strand
evidence: Coordinates (38.627, 20.935) fall on the NW coast of Kalamos island (not the Paleros mainland or Lake Trichonida village): this is the long Myrtia beach of Kalamos, ~1.5km from Kalamos port. Tripadvisor describes it as unspoiled, no infrastructure, only nature; a reviewer notes nothing nearby, a free-camping spot reached by boat/steep path.

name: Μυρτιά
evidence: Adjacent segment of the same ~1.3km Myrtia beach on Kalamos island (38.630, 20.940). Same sources: natural beach with no facilities, no sunbeds, boat/path access only. Disambiguated from Lake Trichonida Myrtia and Paleros mainland by coordinates landing on Kalamos.

name: Παραθάλασσο
evidence: Travelgo article on Monastiraki Fokidas: 'η οργανωμένη παραλία Παραθάλασσο, 500μ δυτικά του χωριού... ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω σε μια μακρόστενη λωρίδα γης με ψιλό βότσαλο' (the 'blue lagoon' beach). Name is unique on this Corinthian-gulf coast so identity is solid; caveat: our pin (21.933) sits ~3-4km west of Monastiraki (nearer Sergoula), so pin placement may be off even though the amenity verdict is well-sourced.

name: Παραλία Αγ. Σπυρίδωνα Λουτρακίου
evidence: Disambiguated to Loutraki of Katouna on the Amvrakikos (sinidisi article confirms the Agios Spyridonas plane-tree/icon in this settlement, feast Aug 11). The article covers the settlement's beaches but names no facilities beyond one seasonal canteen at the main beach; nothing specific found for the Ag. Spyridonas stretch itself — no source claims sunbeds or a bar here, but no explicit 'μη οργανωμένη' either.

name: Παραλία Διόνι
evidence: Dioni at Katochi/Acheloos mouth (Oiniades) — agriniopress cites 'the beach bar Navagio' as a main draw, and 'Mammos Beach Bar Dioni Katochi' operates there since 2022 (its own Facebook page). Beach bar confirmed at this exact locality; no explicit sunbed evidence (local article mentions only sandy/shallow), so sunbeds left null.

name: Παραλία Λουτρακίου
evidence: Loutraki of Katouna, Amvrakikos gulf (sinidisi local article, correct settlement per Wikipedia 'Λουτράκι Αιτωλοακαρνανίας'): only amenity is 'μια καντίνα «ο Μόλος» από ιδιώτη τους καλοκαιρινούς μήνες'; the old café/taverna no longer operate. No sunbeds/umbrellas/beach bar mentioned anywhere; the beachsearcher listing claiming umbrellas+bars is auto-generated and discounted.

name: Παραλία Πατητηρίου
evidence: Greeka's dedicated Patitiri-beach page (pebble beach 200m from Alonissos port — matches the port coords): 'does not offer sunbeds or umbrellas, so visitors are advised to bring towels'; restaurants/cafes are behind the beach in town, not beach facilities. Multiple guides list Rousoum Gialos as the nearest organized beach.

name: Πλάκες
evidence: Rock-slab spot reached on foot from the Alonissos camping just north of Patitiri (matches coords): 'There are no facilities at Plakes (no taverna, no sunbeds, no umbrellas)… carry water and an umbrella'; Tripadvisor reviews describe a secluded hidden beach accessible only on foot.

name: Τζώρτζη
evidence: Greeka + The Wom Travel on the SE-Alonissos bay 6km from Patitiri (matches coords): 'The beach is unorganized, lacking sunbeds and umbrellas… advisable to bring a parasol.' There IS a traditional taverna behind the shore (food/restrooms), but no sunbeds and no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Κάστρου
evidence: Round-1 conflict resolved: both Greeka ('does not boast amenities such as sunbeds or parasols… bring towels') and travel.gr's dedicated Kastro article ('quite unorganised, so if you're looking for shade under an umbrella, you should bring your own') agree there are NO rental sunbeds/umbrellas; there is only the seasonal 'Kastro Beach' canteen selling coffee/refreshments/sandwiches. The 'canteen offers sunbeds' claim found no support in any specific source.

name: Αγιά Θυμιά
evidence: Locality pinned: Pagasitic-gulf side near Lefokastro, South Pelion (Mapcarta/BeachAtlas/hotels.com all place Agia Thymia at Lefokastro, consistent with lat 39.2565 lng 23.1758). Beach guides describe it as 'a spacious pebbly cove that is wild, with no amenities'; only a canteen/camper van selling coffee, water, sweets. No sunbeds/umbrellas/bar anywhere.

name: Βρωμονέρι
evidence: Disambiguated to the Pelion Vromoneri near Katigiorgis (Aegean side, Skiathos view — Tripadvisor Katigiorgis listing + walking-trail pages match coords; not Messinia). Sources conflict: hiking pages describe a taverna-cafe a few dozen metres from the beach with showers, and ilovepelion states 'Η παραλία της είναι οργανωμένη, όπου θα βρείτε εστιατόριο και ξενοδοχείο' — but NO source explicitly mentions sunbeds/umbrellas, and Tripadvisor/trail write-ups read as a quiet sandy cove. No explicit sunbed/bar evidence → not promotable to ORGANIZED.

name: Μικρό
evidence: Greek Wikipedia on Μικρό Μαγνησίας (the Aegean-side beach settlement 8km from Lafkos, next to Platanias — matches coords, distinct from Platanias itself): 'Η παραλία-οικισμός διαθέτει ταβέρνες, καφέ-bar με ενοικιαζόμενες ξαπλώστρες, ξενοδοχεία και ενοικιαζόμενα δωμάτια' — explicit rented sunbeds + café-bars AT Mikro, corroborated by aroundpelion.com.

name: Μορτίτσα
evidence: No source documents any facilities at Mortitsa itself; round-1 describes it as a solitary beach for people who want to be alone. The adjacent, much better-known Mourtias (same SE Pelion stretch matching the pin) is explicitly 'εντελώς ανοργάνωτη — φέρτε δική σας ομπρέλα' (mythessaly.gr) and Greeka states 'no tourist facilities, like umbrellas, sun beds or taverns' for the Mourtia coast. No organized claim exists anywhere; conservative verdict unorganized.

name: Νταμούχαρη
evidence: Guides for the Mamma Mia harbor at Mouresi (matches pin 39.4036,23.1813) agree the beach itself has no sunbeds/umbrellas: 'Unlike larger tourist beaches, Damouchari offers no sunbeds or umbrellas; trees provide natural shade' (greecetravelsecrets/hellenicseason). Tavernas exist by the harbor and one taverna rents lounging chairs under its own olive trees next to the restaurant — not on the beach — so no organized/beach-bar claim on the beach itself.

name: Πάλτση
evidence: Pelioxenia's dedicated Paltsi page (SE Pelion 13km from Argalasti, matches pin): 'During July and August, you'll find sunbeds and parasols available, along with open tavernas serving fresh seafood' — explicit seasonal sunbeds plus two tavernas behind the beach. No beach bar documented; organized = seasonal sunbeds + tavernas only.

name: Παραλία Ανάληψης
evidence: Disambiguated to the Pouri/Zagora Analipsi (pin 39.4688,23.1119, 3.5km from Pouri, north of Chorefto — not the Afissos one). ilovepelion: 'Χωρίς τουριστικές υποδομές και περαιτέρω αξιοποιήσεις, η Ανάληψη δεν είναι παρά ένα ησυχαστήριο' — explicit no tourist infrastructure. The taverna Plymari sits mid-beach but there is no sunbed/umbrella/bar service.

name: Ραζή
evidence: The only documented Razi beach in Pelion is the Pagasitic-side one 'μετά την Άφησσο' near Lefokastro; ilovepelion states explicitly 'εφόσον δεν διαθέτει οργάνωση' — bring your own umbrella and water, shade from tamarisks. Note: our pin (39.2599,23.1733) sits ~7km south of Lefokastro, but no second Razi beach exists in sources; either way no organized claim is supported.

name: Αγία Παρασκευή (Αγιά)
evidence: Pin 39.7235,22.752 lies between Paliouria and Koutsoupia on the Agia coast, but the Dimos Agias official beach list (Agiokampos, Sotiritsa, Velika, Mouka, Koutsoupia, Palouria, Kokkinonero, Platia Ammos, Stomio…) contains no Agia Paraskevi beach, and all searches only surface unrelated Agia Paraskevi beaches (Thesprotia, Chalkidiki, Karystos, Skiathos, Crete). No evidence tied to this cove either way.

name: Παραλία Στρίντζος
evidence: Larissanet feature on Strintzos–Alexandrini (Pineios delta, ~5km from Stomio, matches pin): Strintzos attracts visitors 'who want their peace and quiet' incl. van campers, in the Natura delta with huts; the only service mentioned — 'Για υπηρεσίες υπάρχει beach bar' — is credited to the adjacent Alexandrini beach, not Strintzos itself. No sunbed/umbrella/bar evidence for Strintzos proper.
